result.stdout:
Usage: convert-to-parquet [options...] [-h|--help] [--version]

Convert time-series file to Apache Parquet format.

Options:
  -i, --input-path <string>      Path to the time series file. [Required]
  -o, --output-path <string?>    Output file path; if not provided, the output will be generated next to the input file. [Default: null]
  -f, --force                    Overwrite an existing output file and create the output directory if missing.
